# balena_image_profile (Resource)

Manages a profile name on a Balena release image.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "balena_image_profile" "example" {
  release_image_id = data.balena_release_image.example.id
  profile_name     = "my-profile"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `profile_name` (String) Profile name (1–100 characters).
- `release_image_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the parent release image.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the image profile.
